title: One task storage owner: locateTask and writeTaskRecord behind every krn task verb
body:
Evidence: ADR 0029 decision 3 and migration step 2a (docs/adr/0029-lane-manifest-and-task-writer.md); reproduction .krn/tmp/gemini/d8.test.ts (dep on pending: changeDependency after a pending editTask writes tasks/ while readTask reads the pending ref; on a pending-only task it exits 65 archived) fails on base bb545b1.
Outcome: src/task/storage.ts owns locateTask(root,id) and writeTaskRecord(root,record); the eleven task-record write sites listed in ADR 0029 Context call them or are private helpers of storage.ts; every krn task verb behaves the same on pending, worktree-only and published records.
Proof: a verb-by-storage matrix test (create, show, list, edit, dep add, dep rm, close, publish, take on pending, worktree-only and published records) on a real git fixture, red on base for dep add/rm on pending, green after; the d8 cases become tracked tests.
Files: src/task/storage.ts, src/task/store.ts, src/task/pending.ts, src/cli/lane.ts, test/task/
